name: jev-crowd
description: A social network where people write and 10,000 AI personas read. Every reaction comes from Jev.
author: Ivan Habor

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply jev-crowd --local && wrangler dev --port ${PORT:-5191} --var CROWD_DAILY_LIMIT:0 --var CROWD_DAILY_BUDGET_USD:0
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply jev-crowd --remote && wrangler deploy
